reason: Fix resolveStatementTimeout() in lib/bot-protocol-db.js: it forced every caller-requested statement_timeout up to a 30s floor via Math.max(MIN, requested), silently overriding searchByApplication's intended 8000ms and searchCompatibleElements's intended 5000ms (and autocomplete-fast.js's 700ms). Root-caused via live measurement after a customer reported the web chat not responding: a free-text application query took 54.7s end-to-end on production. Split the old MIN into DEFAULT_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS (used only when a caller omits the option, unchanged at 30000ms) and a much lower MIN_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS (250ms, a sanity floor against 0/negative input) so an explicit shorter caller request is honored instead of raised. Companion to migration 066 (new indexes on elimfilters_catalog), applied and measured first per explicit instruction. Full protocol test suite verified passing (175/175) before close.
